counting_rule: Distinct resources with content inspected; same-site pages are not independent corroboration. Discovery-only and unavailable entries excluded.

sources.title: SakaniUI
sources.evidence: GitHub README, AGENTS, LICENSE and package manifest read
sources.observation: Semantic token layers, component contracts and deliberate block composition are documented.
sources.application: Use real component contracts and one token vocabulary.
sources.limitation: React 19 peer requirement observed; broad accessibility claims not independently certified. MIT file read; linked asset rights need separate checks.

sources.title: Louis CRM filter demo
sources.observation: Customer table has compact navigation, a scoped toolbar, labeled columns and a property-selection filter menu.
sources.application: Borrow table-first hierarchy and filter entry composition.
sources.limitation: Numeric filter continuation timed out; persistence, keyboard behavior and backend not verified. No reuse license checked.

sources.title: Louis unpaid invoice demo
sources.observation: List includes due date, ID, status, description, client and amount; Overdue reduced results to 3 and total to EUR 9700.
sources.application: Keep count, monetary total and filtered records synchronized.
sources.limitation: Other invoice actions and persistence unverified; demo labels do not define accounting rules. No code license checked.

sources.title: Atomic CRM
sources.observation: Documents contacts, tasks, notes, deals, activity history, import/export and customization.
sources.application: Use connected record/activity workflows as the baseline feature model.
sources.limitation: Not installed or runtime-tested; confirm current license and architecture before reuse.

sources.title: Twenty
sources.observation: Describes a customizable CRM with objects, fields and views defined for extension.
sources.application: Separate data model from view presentation.
sources.limitation: Not installed; architectural inspiration, not a drop-in dependency recommendation.

sources.title: Frappe CRM
sources.observation: Documents an all-in-one lead/deal page, kanban and customized filtered views.
sources.application: Keep relevant work and history connected on records.
sources.limitation: Runtime and accessibility not audited; stack and license must be reviewed before copying.

sources.title: tablecn
sources.observation: Lists server queries, configurable columns, advanced filters, selection actions and virtualization.
sources.application: Use as a targeted table interaction reference.
sources.limitation: Features documented by author, not executed here; version compatibility still required.

sources.title: OpenStatus data-table-filters
sources.observation: Documents schema-driven facets, selection controls, state adapters and server-backed pagination.
sources.application: Align schema, controls and query state.
sources.limitation: Observability use differs from CRM; production and CI statements are author claims.

sources.title: shadcn-admin
sources.observation: Documents shared sidebar, global search, themes and specific RTL component modifications.
sources.application: Reuse shell patterns and preserve existing component customizations.
sources.limitation: README explicitly distinguishes this from a starter; auth is partial.

sources.title: Ocean DataView
sources.observation: Maps one property schema to table, list, gallery and board with query state.
sources.application: Keep views of the same records consistent.
sources.limitation: Not runtime-tested; verify version, maturity and license.

sources.title: Midday
sources.observation: Combines financial workflow modules and exports in one business product.
sources.application: Study financial context and related tasks.
sources.limitation: README declares non-commercial/commercial terms; do not assume unrestricted reuse or infer present feature availability from stale sections.

sources.title: KaraBharat CRM dashboard
sources.observation: Documents customer, invoice, lead and analytics UI with modular page structure.
sources.application: Study shared shell and module composition.
sources.limitation: UI source is not proof of production backend, responsiveness or accessibility.

sources.title: Carbon data table
sources.observation: Defines toolbar, headers, rows, optional pagination, density variants and consistent sizing.
sources.application: Make table geometry and action placement deliberate.
sources.limitation: Carbon-specific choices are not mandatory for every CRM.

sources.title: Carbon filtering
sources.observation: Distinguishes instant from batch filtering and requires visible applied-filter indicators/reset.
sources.application: Choose apply behavior from task/query cost.
sources.limitation: Its advice on multi-category menus needs interpretation for richer CRM builders.

sources.title: shadcn data table
sources.observation: A composition guide combines a table with explicit behaviors rather than one universal data-table component.
sources.application: Assemble only required features and verify current API.
sources.limitation: Reviewed guide uses TanStack v9; older projects may use v8.

sources.title: shadcn sidebar
sources.observation: Separates provider, header, content, groups, footer and collapse variants.
sources.application: Centralize shell state and navigation anatomy.
sources.limitation: Use current installed primitive family and preserve local modifications.

sources.title: Radix Dialog
sources.observation: Documents modal/non-modal behavior, title/description, focus management and Escape.
sources.application: Use an established overlay primitive with correct mode.
sources.limitation: Application composition still needs verification.

sources.title: React Aria Table
sources.observation: Documents table navigation, optional selection/sorting and cell focus configuration.
sources.application: Choose an explicit accessible interaction model.
sources.limitation: Do not mix keyboard models casually; not a runtime audit.

sources.title: Tabler Icons
sources.observation: Documents consistent SVG grid/stroke with configurable appearance.
sources.application: Use coherent optical size and weight.
sources.limitation: Do not treat icon counts as stable or assume every identifier exists in installed version.

sources.title: Lucide stroke width
sources.observation: Explains stroke customization and size-relative versus non-scaling strokes.
sources.application: Keep small and large icon weights consistent.
sources.limitation: Current and older versions use different non-scaling prop names; inspect installed API.

sources.title: WAI-ARIA grid pattern
sources.observation: Composite grids require managed internal focus and differ from ordinary table tab order.
sources.application: Use native table unless composite interactions justify a grid.
sources.limitation: APG is implementation guidance; a role alone supplies no keyboard behavior.

sources.title: WCAG target size minimum
sources.observation: AA criterion sets a 24 CSS-pixel target minimum with specified exceptions.
sources.application: Evaluate hit area and spacing, not just visible glyph.
sources.limitation: 44-pixel touch preference in this skill is a comfort default, not this AA threshold.

sources.title: WCAG focus not obscured
sources.observation: Focused controls must not be entirely hidden by author-created content.
sources.application: Check sticky toolbars, menus and inspector focus.
sources.limitation: Aim for full visibility; do not misstate the criterion's minimum.

sources.title: WCAG text contrast
sources.observation: Sets normal/large text contrast requirements and exceptions.
sources.application: Measure actual text/background pairs.
sources.limitation: A palette alone cannot certify all rendered states.

sources.title: WCAG dragging movements
sources.observation: Dragging functionality needs a single-pointer non-drag alternative unless excepted.
sources.application: Add move-to-stage actions besides board dragging.
sources.limitation: Keyboard support alone does not satisfy the single-pointer alternative.

sources.title: WAI-ARIA modal dialog
sources.observation: Describes inert background, initial focus, contained tab sequence and dialog semantics.
sources.application: Make modal drawers function as dialogs.
sources.limitation: Do not impose a modal trap on a non-modal inspector.

sources.title: WAI-ARIA combobox
sources.observation: Distinguishes editable/select-only controls and associated popup behaviors.
sources.application: Build searchable owners/relations with an established pattern.
sources.limitation: Not every dropdown is a combobox.

sources.title: NN/G complex applications
sources.observation: Recommends retaining capability while reducing clutter and easing transitions to secondary information.
sources.application: Use progressive disclosure without deleting important workflows.
sources.limitation: General guidance needs task-specific validation.

sources.title: NN/G icon usability
sources.observation: Explains that icon recognition depends on experience and ambiguous meanings need labels.
sources.application: Label critical and unfamiliar actions visibly.
sources.limitation: A tooltip is not always a substitute for a visible label.

sources.title: GOV.UK error summary
sources.observation: Pairs summary-level error navigation with field-level messages.
sources.application: Make longer forms recoverable without re-entry.
sources.limitation: Adapt visual styling to the product; do not copy public-service branding.

sources.title: PatternFly empty states
sources.observation: Separates no results, setup, no access and backend failure contexts.
sources.application: Give state-specific recovery rather than a generic empty card.
sources.limitation: Do not equate denied access or failure with no data.

sources.title: Attio filter and sort views
sources.observation: Documents property/condition/value filters, groups, and saved versus temporary shared-view changes.
sources.application: Make filter logic and save scope explicit.
sources.limitation: Attio-specific persistence rules need not be copied unchanged.

sources.title: Attio data model
sources.observation: Distinguishes objects, relationships, lists and views.
sources.application: Avoid duplicating records merely to present different subsets.
sources.limitation: Choose domain cardinality from the actual brief.

sources.title: HubSpot saved views
sources.observation: Documents filters, view types, columns, sorting and sharing configuration.
sources.application: Treat saved views as explicit reusable configurations.
sources.limitation: Product-specific limits and entitlements are not universal CRM rules.

sources.title: Pipedrive pipeline view
sources.observation: Cards summarize deals and next activities, with full details and won/lost outcomes.
sources.application: Connect pipeline progression to real activities and records.
sources.limitation: Do not assume moving a card is a complete validated transition.

sources.title: Dashboard Design Patterns
sources.observation: Distinguishes data, metadata, visual encoding, interaction, and composition patterns.
sources.application: Design dashboards around questions and information relationships.
sources.limitation: This skill's specific CRM templates are original synthesis, not validated outcomes of the paper.

sources.title: Anthropic frontend-design skill
sources.observation: Advocates brief-specific intent, a small design plan and self-critique.
sources.application: Make domain-specific visual decisions and critique the result.
sources.limitation: Marketing-oriented novelty rules need restraint in daily CRM work; source not copied.

sources.title: Vercel web-design-guidelines skill
sources.observation: Routes audits through current interface guidance and concrete code findings.
sources.application: Keep review rules evidence-backed and current.
sources.limitation: Optional companion, not a dependency or permission grant.

sources.title: Impeccable
sources.observation: Describes separate shaping, audit, hardening and polish activities.
sources.application: Separate product truth, visual direction and quality review.
sources.limitation: README capabilities not executed here; reject mechanical font/color bans when they harm the brief.

sources.title: Emil Kowalski: Great Animations
sources.observation: Discusses response speed, purpose, frequency, easing and accessibility.
sources.application: Use motion to explain changes without delaying frequent work.
sources.limitation: Timings are contextual; this skill's token values are starting defaults.

sources.title: Emil Kowalski: Agents with Taste
sources.observation: Explains making design judgments explicit enough to guide agents.
sources.application: Turn vague polish requests into specific rules and examples.
sources.limitation: Does not guarantee any agent's output quality.

sources.title: Rauno Freiberg: Interaction Design
sources.observation: Examines familiar metaphors, intent and interruptible interactions.
sources.application: Preserve control, continuity and predictability.
sources.limitation: Essay observations are not normative accessibility requirements.

sources.title: Rauno Freiberg: Novelty
sources.observation: Relates repeated actions to reduced value of extravagant visual novelty.
sources.application: Keep frequent actions quiet; reserve distinction for meaningful moments.
sources.limitation: Author presents a hypothesis, not a measured universal law.

sources.title: mxkaske Craft
sources.evidence: Author index and indexed table description read
sources.observation: Catalogs interaction explorations including a data-table controls/filter example.
sources.application: Use as a discovery route to focused interaction examples.
sources.limitation: Index-level review only; no independent behavior audit or component adoption.

sources.title: Vercel Web Interface Guidelines
sources.evidence: Guidelines page and repository command source read
sources.observation: Covers keyboard/focus, input behavior, URL state, mutation feedback and interface details.
sources.application: Review interaction details as well as visual styling.
sources.limitation: Conflicting zoom/overflow suggestions must not override accessibility; no blanket compliance claim.

sources.title: nuqs basic usage
sources.observation: Synchronizes component state with URL query values.
sources.application: Preserve shareable navigation/filter state where safe.
sources.limitation: Sensitive criteria may belong behind a saved-view ID; URL state is not access control.

sources.title: TanStack v8 pagination
sources.observation: Manual pagination assumes pre-paginated data and needs totals for known page counts.
sources.application: Keep server/client pagination responsibilities explicit.
sources.limitation: Version-specific v8 source; do not apply its APIs to a v9 implementation.

sources.title: WCAG non-text contrast
sources.observation: Required control and state visual information has contrast requirements against adjacent colors.
sources.application: Check borders/icons/state indicators that convey necessary meaning.
sources.limitation: Decorative separators and inactive states have distinctions/exceptions.

sources.title: WCAG reflow
sources.observation: Describes reflow without loss of information/function with exceptions for necessary two-dimensional content.
sources.application: Test narrow/zoomed layouts while allowing legitimate table scrolling.
sources.limitation: Table exception does not exempt surrounding controls or the entire app.

sources.title: web.dev INP
sources.observation: Defines interaction latency and field percentile thresholds.
sources.application: Measure responsive feedback and avoid blocking interactions.
sources.limitation: Local tests do not establish field INP or production performance.

sources.title: Louis customer list and drawer
sources.evidence: Page content retrieved; visual interaction not tested
sources.observation: Content includes a customer grid and record details with relationship/contact fields and work tabs.
sources.application: Use as a contextual record-inspector reference.
sources.limitation: No claim of tested focus, persistence, tab behavior or accessible drawer implementation.

sources.title: SakaniUI CRM composition source
sources.observation: Source describes an icon rail, entity tabs, collapsible filters, toolbar, table and footer assembled from primitives.
sources.application: Study composition while supplying application-specific data/behavior.
sources.limitation: Separate resource in same repository as S01; not an additional independent publisher. No copied source or avatar assets.
